mapper.sql: job_id,store_id,CAST(creator_json AS CHAR) creator_json,CAST(content_json AS CHAR) content_json,status,available_at,cursor_index,succeeded,conflicted,attempts,error_code,version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM catalog_operation_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM catalog_operation_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND job_id>#{after} ORDER BY job_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT item_index,sku_id,status,expected_revision,actual_revision,reason,processed_at FROM catalog_operation_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} AND item_index>#{after} ORDER BY item_index LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_operation_job SET status=IF(#{complete},'COMPLETED','RUNNING'),cursor_index=cursor_index+1,succeeded=succeeded+IF(#{success},1,0),conflicted=conflicted+IF(#{success},0,1),attempts=0,error_code=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE catalog_operation_job SET status=#{status},attempts=0,error_code=NULL,available_at=GREATEST(run_at,#{now}),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE catalog_operation_job SET status=IF(attempts+1>=5,'ISOLATED','RUNNING'),attempts=attempts+1,error_code=#{code},available_at=#{next},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_id=#{id} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM catalog_operation_job WHERE tenant_id>#{after} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','RUNNING') AND available_at<=#{now} ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
SELECT job_id FROM catalog_operation_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','RUNNING') AND available_at<=#{now} ORDER BY available_at,job_id LIMIT 1
